controls.name: 5/7 multiplicity bound chain (review A section 7)
controls.verification: Inline written check: for p in {5,7} and labels S with p|n_i, pairwise gcds equal exactly p (only multiple of p not exceeding 7); an outside label j has gcd(n_i,n_j) not divisible by p (else 5 or 7 would divide n_j), hence its prime divisors lie in the other three primes of {2,3,5,7}; distinctness across S follows since p*q>7; |S|<=3; at |S|=3 every outside index is divisible by 2,3,7 so any two outside labels have gcd divisible by 42>7, contradicting gcd<=7, and five outside labels exist; hence |S|<=2 per p and at least four of the eight indices are coprime to 35. PASS.

controls.name: D7 gcd transfer (review D)
controls.verification: Inline written check: m_i the 7-smooth part of n_i; pairwise original gcds lie in {2,...,7} hence are already 7-smooth, so gcd(m_i,m_j)=gcd(n_i,n_j); m_i>1 since gcd(n_i,n_j)>=2 for some j. PASS.

controls.name: A-M1 residual qualification
controls.verification: Inline: a simple least counterexample has no proper nontrivial normal cut, so the normal-extension residual alone cannot exclude it; the all-prime cyclic case is elementarily excluded (eight singleton cosets need p>=8, forcing pair gcd p>7). Confirms the MINOR qualification is required and correct.
